scope: Completed exploratory screens and confirmations for six independently frozen prototypes. The packaged follow-up is linked separately; its final raw observations are not appended to this historical record.

path_conventions.bundle_relative_paths: artifacts.*.path, production_only_patch.path, and packaged_followup.artifact.path are relative to the directory containing this JSON.
path_conventions.original_source_paths: Other file receipt path fields, observation source_file values and diagnostics source values preserve coordinates relative to the original source-path base. They are provenance records, not links to files included in the bundle.
path_conventions.baseline_source_paths: baseline_path values are relative to the repository root at the recorded baseline commit.
path_conventions.commands: Absolute classpath/executable/input paths remain unchanged as historical execution receipts; relocation does not make these commands directly runnable.
path_conventions.relocation: Move the evidence directory as a unit. Its report/data/patch links remain relative. JARs, class files and standalone driver sources are represented by identities, not copied into the documentation bundle.

recorded_identity.scope: Exact previously measured JAR; current main has the identical source tree. Baseline symlink avoids duplicating artifacts.

baseline.jar_identity_note: The existing immutable baseline artifact identity is checked against every recorded group environment; no new JAR was built by evidence assembly.

receipt.comparison_scope: javap -c -p (methods and bytecode, excludes debug tables); analysis pinned to CPU0 outside measurement CPUs4-7

common_probe.source_binding: Root confirms the common helper was compiled from the unchanged baseline Cr3ImportProbe.java with javac --release 21 in the prior round and reused in both arms.
common_probe.binary_binding_note: Common helper and JAR class byte hashes differ. Root independently verified identical javap -c -p output; byte-for-byte class equality is not claimed.

method.serialization: The measurement runner holds /workspace/scratch/80a209e8f5df/cr3-performance.lock. Evidence assembly only reads files and runs git show; it does not acquire the measurement lock or execute Java/Maven.
method.timing_scope: Complete fresh ImageIO import; dimensions, format validation and full numeric hash are checked outside the read timer. Filesystem caches were not flushed.
method.screen: One fresh JVM per arm/input, five warmups and seven recorded imports; baseline then candidate.
method.confirmation: Two fresh JVMs per arm/input, eight warmups and eleven recorded imports; AB then BA, with input order reversed in fork two.
method.input_scope_note: sample-wide.cr3 has a preserved baseline file identity but was not timed in these six-variant screen groups.
method.heap_scope: All full-import observations here use -Xmx768m and Serial GC; standalone numerical-driver heaps are separate.
method.aggregation: Medians are calculated within each process. Group summaries use the median of process medians. RSS uses the maximum observed process value, matching the original runner.
method.comparison_scope: Do not rank absolute timings across separate screen/confirmation groups or across JDKs. Decisions use each candidate and its own contemporaneous control.
method.memory_metric_limits: Managed allocation, used heap and process-lifetime high-water RSS are separate metrics. RSS includes startup/warmup and is not live workspace; array-payload checks exclude headers and collector overhead.
method.output_hash_scope: All 344 timed observations retain complete-image full-u16le-or-u8 FNV-1a-64 fingerprints, dimensions, channel count and depth. Hash equality is supported by independent stage exactness checks; it is not a cryptographic proof.

variants.hypothesis: Remove construction and application of the ordinary Rice remainder mask using the exact unary-terminator identity: after shifting the complete ordinary codeword, the value is 2^k plus remainder, so adding (q-1)<<k yields (q<<k)+remainder; hold refill, consumption, escape and state update unchanged.
variants.preparation_status_note: Preparation files are retained as historical source records; their unexecuted/uncompiled wording is superseded only by the later execution receipts below.

decision.reason: The one-fork Java 21 screen was mixed: G5 elapsed/CPU improved, EOS elapsed regressed slightly. This does not establish a repeatable general benefit; no production promotion.
decision.authority: Root selection decision; supported by the retained within-group summaries.

selection.phase: Historical prototype-screen selection; this is not a production acceptance decision.
selection.next_gate: Final packaged artifact, complete imports and memory/compatibility validation owned by root.
selection.screen_prototype_vs_final_note: Prototype patches describe exactly the screen sources. They do not include the later shared tone-table reserve or final repository tests.

observations.preservation: Every original observation key/value is retained, with variant, protocol, fork, arm and source file/line added. No observation is filtered as an outlier.

diagnostics.preservation: Every process stderr file is retained losslessly as a deduplicated text blob; whole stage/compile logs are also retained because their stdout/stderr were merged.

independent_read_only_receipt_audit.diagnostic_result: Exactness logs contain only SLF4J no-provider diagnostics; no failure, exception or OOM diagnostics were found.
independent_read_only_receipt_audit.execution_limit: The independent audit read source, class headers, manifests and logs; it ran no builds, Java, tests or benchmarks.

provenance_limits: Rice and optical numerical receipts identify JDKs through filenames/runner bindings but do not print their runtime version themselves.
Rice standalone driver class files were not in the screen environment class inventory; current driver source and receipt hashes are retained.
Preparation README/manifest states describe their original pre-execution point. Later receipts, rather than silently rewritten preparation text, establish successful checks.

The original screen runner did not embed the external shared helper class hash in each environment. The separate independently audited probe identity now binds that common helper without changing historical records.

decision.reason: The Java 21 wide-capture elapsed and CPU median regressions recur in both Serial GC and G1. Numerical checks passed, but the complete-import performance benefit is not portable across the tested inputs and runtimes.
decision.authority: Root decision after all five frozen-d61 groups completed.
decision.causal_limit: These full-import observations do not establish the cause. Bounded stage diagnosis and any successor candidate are separate work and are excluded.

packaged_followup.historical_record_limit: The preliminary PROCEED decision above is preserved. The frozen packaged successor failed the portable performance gate and is not published as-is. Its 456 observations are separate from the 344 prototype observations here.
